rules.source: Law No. 13 of 2016 on Personal Data Privacy Protection (Qatar) — https://www.clym.io/regulations/law-no13-of-2016-qatar
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: consent is the main basis for processing with a legitimate-purpose exception; individuals may object, correct, delete and access data; data of special nature includes ethnic origin, children, health, religious beliefs, marital relations and criminal offences. Sources conflict on the regulator and on effective dates.

rules.source: Law No. 14 of 2014 on Combating Cybercrimes (Qatar) — https://sherloc.unodc.org/cld/uploads/res/document/the-cybercrime-prevention-law_html/Qatar_Cybercrime_Law_unofficial_translation.pdf (also https://www.tamimi.com/law-update/october-4/articles/cyber-crime-prevention-law-in-qatar/)
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: promulgated Sept 2014; covers hacking, fraud and content offences; unauthorised access to systems carries up to 3 years' imprisonment; producing or distributing child pornography up to five years; Article 21 requires providers to keep subscriber information for one year. Commentary notes undefined 'false news' terms.
